limitations: Eight parametric plane methods are sampled; other construction methods remain unsupported.
OffsetThroughPoint and ordinary Offset share cached mode1; the native backend method code distinguishes their definitions.
New plane geometry is recovered from stored native caches, independently checked against API output; it is not rebuilt from support inputs.
Tangent face supports retain explicit historical body IDs and persistent face recipes; exact ASM faces and tangent construction regeneration remain unresolved.
Sketch-point supports are explicit sketchID/entitytag associations with decoded native component placement; occurrence transforms are not inferred.
ExtraOffset optional bindings are retained; only zero values are sampled, so their general geometric effect remains unverified.
OffsetThroughPoint AlongDistance is a stored evaluated parameter; its defining support is the explicit point input.
Backend geometry prefix bytes and later shared metadata are preserved or bounded without interpreting their general field meanings.
No native file writer or parametric construction regeneration is implemented.
